NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Information Technology Security Policy
 Document ID
NT-IT-003
Department
Information Technology
Version
4.0
Effective Date
15 January 2025
1. Passwords
Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and include uppercase letters, lowercase letters,
numbers and one special character. Passwords must be changed every 90 days. The last 5
passwords cannot be reused. Employees must never share passwords, even with IT staff.
2. Multi-Factor Authentication
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for email, VPN, the code repository and the cloud
console. The approved MFA method is the NovaTech Authenticator app. SMS-based codes are
not allowed.
3. Device Security
All company laptops have full-disk encryption enabled. Screens lock automatically after 5 minutes
of inactivity. USB storage devices are blocked by default; exceptions need written approval from
the IT Security team. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT Helpdesk within 2 hours.
4. Incident Reporting
Any suspected security incident, such as a phishing email or malware, must be reported to
security@novatech.example immediately. The Security Operations Centre will acknowledge
reports within 30 minutes. Critical incidents are resolved or escalated within 4 hours.
5. Software Installation
Only software from the approved software catalogue may be installed. Requests for new software
are raised through the IT Service Portal and are reviewed within 3 working days.
6. Data Classification
Company data is classified into four levels: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted. Restricted
data, such as customer financial records, must never be stored on personal devices or personal
cloud storage.
7. Security Awareness Training
Every employee must complete the annual security awareness training within 30 days of joining
and once every year after that. Employees who fail the phishing simulation test twice must repeat
the training.
Document Notice

Confidentiality Notice: This document is the property of NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and is
intended for internal use by employees only. Unauthorised copying, sharing or distribution outside
the company is prohibited. For clarifications, contact the People and Culture team at
hr@novatech.example.
